Threat Scenarios: SOURCE-MASS-REPOSITORY-DELETION: A compromised GitHub administrator session or mistaken administration destroys product-critical repositories branches tags or history.; SOURCE-BACKUP-CO-DESTRUCTION: The same GitHub authority can delete both the source repository and a same-domain mutable backup.; SOURCE-RECOVERY-FALSE-ASSURANCE: An incomplete unretained or never-restored backup is assumed to provide product recovery.
Threat Actor or Source: product inventory drift repository rename transfer or an administrator who overlooks a product-critical repository
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: deletion restrictions and backups cover a visible subset while an omitted repository is destroyed and prevents rebuilding patching or investigation
Why This Check Is Required: safeguards can protect only the repositories selected for them and another repository backup cannot replace omitted product source
Required State: the product owner identifies every repository required for rebuilding security patching or incident investigation by GitHub numeric repository ID and assigns an owner RPO and RTO
Verification Method: product owner and repository admin compare the complete paginated GitHub organization inventory with the product build and incident dependencies
Expected Result: every required repository appears once by numeric GitHub ID with an owner RPO and RTO and exclusions have an explicit reason
Required Evidence: reviewed critical-repository register and dated product-owner approval
